title: UX Feature Request: Improve the "Move to" menu on Android (Currently unusable with large databases)
summary: As my Foliole database has grown, I've noticed a significant UX bottleneck on the Android app when using the "Move to" feature for nodes/extracts. ​Currently, the "Move to" dropdown displays a flat, unsearchable, and un-collapsible list of every single node and cloze in the entire database. When you have hundreds or thousands of highlights, this list becomes infinitely long. Manually scrolling through this massive list to find the correct target folder or parent node is incredibly tedious, frustrating, and practically unusable on a small mobile screen. (I've attached a screen recording demonstrating this scrolling issue). https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8132729a-8139-424c-9e63-956c2f64edd9

title: [Feature]: Mobile chat button to jump/scroll to the beginning of an LLM response
summary: ### Problem or use case When interacting with agents on the Orca mobile app (Android / iOS), LLM responses are often very long (containing markdown explanations, extensive code snippets, and tool execution logs). As the agent streams its response, the viewport typically auto-scrolls to the very bottom. Once the response completes (or while reading), the user is stranded at the end of a long wall of text. On a mobile touch screen, manually swiping up across dozens of viewports just to find where the LLM began its reply is slow and frustrating. Currently, the mobile UI only provides a floating 'jump to latest' (downward) control. ### Proposed solution Add a button or navigation control in the mobile chat view to scroll directly to the beginning/start of an LLM response: 1. Jump to Start of Response Button: A floating or inline navigation control (e.g. an upward jump button alongside the existing 'jump to latest' control, or an action at the bottom of the message) that scrolls the viewport smoothly to the top of the current/latest assistant turn. 2. Intelligent Alignment: Align the top of the assistant's message header with the top of the viewport, so the user can immediately begin reading the response from line 1. 3. Message Boundary Awareness: If tapped repeatedly or when viewing older turns, step up to the start of previous assistant responses, skipping intermediate tool execution rows and system noise. ### Alternatives or additional context - Existing work: Similar to or building upon PR #37238 ('feat(mobile): step back to the previous message in chat') and Issue #37237. - Current workaround: Manually flicking/swiping up on mobile screen repeatedly, which is tedious and often overshoots the start of the message.
